issue.title: Extend artifact-ref use wire to schema 2 with the §3.7 field set
issue.description: Extend the artifact-ref use wire to schema 2 with the epic's §3.7 field set (span, project, provider, origin, properties, captured_revision, captured_digest); schema 1 only persists a subset today. Proposed by sase-js.4 (Builtin refs and prompt ref context) during landing of epic sase-js (Artifact reference contract).

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-k5 — both are sase-js.4 follow-ups touching the same @stitch/@patch artifact-ref wire subsystem in sase-core; sase-k5 migrates entry resolution (replacing unknown_kind arms) while this task extends the use wire's persisted schema. Coordinate to avoid rework/collision in the same wire types.

payload.close_reason: Backlog cut to seven (owner-requested, 2026-08-12): deferred as a batch. All six are sase-js.4/.5/.6 follow-ups that extend the artifact-reference contract (epic sase-js, landed and closed) rather than defects against it -- entry-resolution migration into core, use-wire schema 2, sha-to-Patch mapping, launch-approval @file preview, provider Referenced By column vocabulary, and v2 ref-uses.json publication. Nothing is broken today: @stitch/@patch resolve through the Python arms, schema 1 persists its subset, and referenced-by write-back works from the local manifest. Each is large, and k5/k6/k7 plus k9/ka overlap in the same core wire types by their own RELATED notes, so working them as six independent large tasks invites rework. The epic's plan sections (3.4, 3.7, 3.8) still record the intended design. Re-propose as one follow-on epic plan when this subsystem is next prioritized.
